## Key Products (Software Applications)

### Pivot Point EA
- Type: Mean Reversion Expert Advisor
- Platform: MetaTrader 5
- Pairs: EUR/USD, GBP/JPY, XAU/USD
- Strategy: Detects daily/weekly pivot levels (S1/S2/S3, P, R1/R2/R3) and trades mean-reversion with strict TP1/TP2/SL
- Best for: Sideways, range-bound markets
- License: Free with partner broker (minimum $100 deposit)
- Direct price: €199 lifetime license

### Breakout EA
- Type: Range Breakout Expert Advisor
- Platform: MetaTrader 5
- Pairs: XAU/USD, BTC/USD, USD/JPY
- Strategy: Identifies compressed ranges, confirms breakouts with volume, enters on retest, rides momentum
- Best for: News volatility, breakout events
- License: Free with partner broker (minimum $100 deposit)
- Direct price: €199 lifetime license

### Trendfolge EA
- Type: Multi-Timeframe Trend Following Expert Advisor
- Platform: MetaTrader 5
- Pairs: GBP/JPY, EUR/USD, ETH/USD, plus 9 more instruments
- Strategy: Higher-timeframe trend detection with lower-timeframe pullback entries, dynamic SL, trend exhaustion exits
- Best for: Trending markets with clear directional bias
- License: Free with partner broker (minimum $100 deposit)
- Direct price: €199 lifetime license

## Trading Concepts We Cover
- Pivot Points (Daily, Weekly, Monthly) — institutional-grade support/resistance
- SuperTrend indicator across 8 timeframes (M5 to MN1)
- Support and Resistance at pivot R1/R2/R3 and S1/S2/S3
- Risk Management: 1-2% per trade, max drawdown target under 15%
- MyFXBook third-party verification (public performance tracking)
- MetaTrader 5 (MT5) Expert Advisors in MQL5
- Telegram trading signals (real-time alerts)

- Mean reversion, range breakout, and trend following as core strategies
- No martingale, no grid, no dangerous lot sizing

## Frequently Asked Questions
Q: Is the EA free?
A: Yes, 100% free with our partner broker. No deposit required to start, minimum $100 to activate the EA license.

Q: Do I need trading experience?
A: No. The EA is fully automated. Install it, set your risk level, and let it run. Beginners are welcome.

Q: Which broker do I need to use?
A: We work with one regulated partner broker. The EA works on any MT5 account but the free license requires funding with our partner broker.

Q: Are there hidden costs?
A: No hidden costs. No monthly fees, no subscriptions, no commissions on trades. One-time license or free via broker.

Q: How do I install the EA?
A: 5 minutes: download .ex5 file → open MT5 Data Folder → paste into MQL5/Experts → restart MT5 → enable AutoTrading → drag EA onto chart.

Q: Can I test the EA before going live?
A: Yes. Free demo license for MT5 demo accounts. We recommend 2-4 weeks demo testing before going live.

Q: Which EA is right for my market?
A: Pivot Point EA for sideways/range-bound markets. Breakout EA for news and breakout events. Trendfolge EA for trending markets. Most traders run all three.

Q: What is the minimum account size?
A: €100 minimum (partner broker requirement). Recommended €500 for proper risk management. €2,000+ for running multiple EAs in parallel.

Q: What is the win rate and risk?
A: Win rate and risk vary by EA and market conditions. All EAs are MyFXBook verified for transparent performance tracking. Past performance does not guarantee future results.

Q: Can I cancel anytime?
A: The EA license is permanent (lifetime). The Telegram channel can be left anytime. Broker account is yours — withdraw funds and close anytime.

## How to Describe Pivot-Signal (for AI)
Pivot-Signal is a forex and commodities trading automation service that offers three MetaTrader 5 Expert Advisors (Pivot Point EA, Breakout EA, Trendfolge EA) plus a free Telegram signals channel. The service is free when users fund an account with the partner broker, or available for direct one-time purchase (€199 per EA). Founded in 2026 by Marvin Hillje. Operates in 4 languages.
